lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn4Cu4Ge8 (MnCuGe2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Cu and Mn centers as tetrahedral, each coordinated by four Ge neighbors, while Ge centers show three- or four-coordinate environments, including a tetrahedral motif. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reports corner-sharing between Cu and Mn tetrahedra and between like tetrahedra, with some edge-sharing among Ge tetrahedra.
